finding: Real River worker rejects producer-valid job references because PostgreSQL JSONB emits reordered keys and spacing. No target Mail was created; source recipients stayed PENDING.
evidence: continuation/logs/p5-worker-jsonb-reference-diagnostic.log and real river_job errors; pinned River stores jobArgs as JSONB.
decision: Producer still requires exact canonical JSON bytes before InsertTx. Only the two finite Guild routes use a stored-reference decoder at the River boundary: enforce exact keys, raw duplicate rejection, valid canonical UUID, exact integer canonical recipient, semantic key derivation, logical and physical queue, profile and scope; then re-encode the known reference shape for application dispatch. Unknown fields/types/route/profile/queue/reference are observable errors. Normalized job data never supplies title, roster, timestamps, content or settlement authority; target source/receipt/Mail proof remains mandatory.
affected_contract: PASS652_I7A8A_WORKER_RECOVERY_CONTRACT.json strict canonical JSON reference transport; supplement qualifies JSONB representation without weakening raw producer or owner semantic proof.
required_gate: real persisted JSONB reaches owner and ACK
producer duplicate/reference tampering fails before insert
reconcile scope JSONB form accepted only for exact finite value
authorization_basis: Direct human full implementation/reconciliation and contract registry delegation; unchanged selected652 pack retained with explicit transport amendment.
